* feat(react): deprecate height props of SidePanelBody

Mark height, minHeight, and maxHeight on SidePanelBody and
ResponsiveSidePanelBody as @deprecated ahead of their removal in SEED React
3.0.0. The side panel body always fills the height left between the header
and footer, so these props either do nothing or break the footer position.

ResponsiveSidePanelBody redeclares them because a property of an
intersection type is only reported as deprecated when every constituent
declares it so.
